key_insight: A solver-guided LLM can choose the best mixed-integer programming formulation for each multi-warehouse inventory instance, improving allocation quality beyond any single fixed formulation.
engineering_relevance: This turns OR model selection into an instance-wise decision problem, helping e-commerce planning systems adapt formulations to changing demand, inventory, and service regimes.
method: Build a candidate library of solver-executable MIP formulations, each encoding a different allocation priority.
Create balanced supervised fine-tuning data for schema learning, then derive margin-weighted preference data from solver-evaluated quality gaps.
Train the selector with IPO and GRPO, using per-instance expert-score metadata as reward lookup during policy optimization.
evidence_signal: On JD.com inventory allocation instances, GRPO raised Hit Ratio@1 from 21.45% to 50.42% and Hit Ratio@2 from 70.47% to 82.31%, and improved allocation accuracy by 12.57 percentage points over the incumbent baseline.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of the expert library and solver-labeled historical instances, so deployment may be sensitive to domain shift and the cost of generating preference data.
paper_title: Large Language Model for Operations Research Formulation Selection in Multi-Warehouse Inventory Allocation
